label: Crossing the Line Once More: B

lines.text: The sky is dotted with explosions.
Dorothy watches as Annihilio plummets, engulfed in flames.
The barrel of her gun remains trained on Annihilio.

lines.speaker: sora_op_l
lines.text: Confirmed, Annihilio has been shot down! ★

lines.speaker: sora_op_l
lines.text: Oh, it does have something resembling a core inside, so please be caref—
Before Sora can finish speaking, Annihilio's core surges up through the flames.
Without changing her aim, Dorothy pulls the trigger.
A beam of light pierces straight through Annihilio's black core,
and it plummets to the ground in a fiery explosion.

lines.speaker: sora_op_l
lines.text: Amazing! ★

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: All clear.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Your skills haven't dulled a bit.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It's just a missile with a few extra features tacked on.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It's hardly worthy of being called a Heretic.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: That might change if dozens of them came at you all at once.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I suppose so.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Well, good work at any rate.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: I sent you out to get some fresh air. Who would've thought you'd end up in a battle.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... You certainly know how to spin things.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Well, I've got to make it sound good somehow, don't I?

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: So, how does it feel to have a successful debut under your belt?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: What else? I'm talking about your debut as the vanguard of the Third Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I never agreed to that.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: It seems others see it differently.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Oh, did I not mention it?

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: This battle is being broadcast live to the Ark.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Everyone in the Ark witnessed your heroics firsthand.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Dorothy, the leader of the Goddess Squad, aboard the Wings of Victory.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Striking down Heretics, humanity's greatest enemy.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: It was such a magnificent sight, I couldn't resist showing it off.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: It caused quite a stir. Want me to play back the cheers for you?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: No, thank you. You've grown quite cunning in your old age.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Please, it's painful enough being old without being reminded.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Anyway, you can't back out now. You have to lead the charge.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: After all this, that'd be rather poor form, don't you think?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Fine. I'll do it.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'll lead the Third Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: As expected, you haven't changed a bit.

lines.speaker: andersen_op_r
lines.text: There's the Dorothy I remember.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Hmph.
*Rumble, rumble*
The sound of wheels rolling echoes across the deck. Dorothy turns toward the source of the noise.
Sora and Cielo are pushing a trolley over, on it rests an elegantly designed teacup.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Your plum blossom tea, as requested. ♥

lines.speaker: cielo
lines.text: The wind is quite strong here, so I'm afraid the tea may cool too quickly. Please enjoy it while it's still hot.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... I'll go inside to drink it.
In Burningum's office.
Burningum stares blankly into space.
He reaches out and presses the button on the machine before him.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Fine. I'll do it.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'll lead the Third Surface Reclamation War.
Burningum continues staring vacantly.
He reaches out and presses the button again.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Fine. I'll do it.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'll lead the Third Surface Reclamation War.
He falls into a daze again.
A moment later...
Burningum clenches his fist.
He silently cheers in triumph.
His quiet jubilation continues until Enikk contacts him.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Enikk. Give me an update.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Preparations for the Third Surface Reclamation War are proceeding smoothly.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Public sentiment has stabilized thanks to the large-scale relay concert series that kicked off with T.T. STAR.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: During the concert, Mustang made continuous remarks hinting at the surface reclamation war, which naturally spread throughout the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We have determined that the Ark will not descend into chaos whenever the Third Surface Reclamation War is officially declared.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The strategy of using entertainment to dilute the fear associated with war...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That's something I would like to learn from as well.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: There were three major issues concerning the Ark, all of which are now being addressed in sequence.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Firstly, the Ark's levitation function.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Thanks to continuous maintenance by Missilis Industry, we have determined that this function will operate without issue.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Ark is a city built atop a massive lift. Raising the city itself requires an enormous amount of power.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: At present, the Ark's power source is currently operating at drastically reduced output, leaving insufficient power to operate the lift.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I assess that this issue can be resolved with the assistance of the Electric Shock Squad, along with Endless and Eternity.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Secondly, the Ark's infrastructure.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Ark has undergone significant expansions since its original construction.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I've determined that all such additions must be dismantled to ensure the smooth operation of the lift.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Dismantling is currently underway with the support of the Mighty Tools and Hammer & Drill Squads.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Citizens who lose their homes or workplaces in this process are being supported with temporary housing and employment provided by the Central Government.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Furthermore, the Dome of Eternity and all elevators must be dismantled prior to the Ark's ascent.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Due to the exceedingly high risk of accidents caused by the impact during ascent, dismantling is mandatory.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Elevators are being dismantled in sequence, starting with those with the lowest usage, and the Dome of Eternity is scheduled to be dismantled immediately before the Ark's ascent.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: During the Ark's ascent, all citizens will be required to enter the evacuation shelters.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: To prevent accidents, citizens will be advised not to remain at home or in designated areas.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Hmm... So when the Ark ascends, all of the Ark's infrastructure will go offline.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is correct. While preventing accidents is also a consideration, it is also because we must conserve as much power as possible.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Understood. What is the third issue, then?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Outer Rim is located on the periphery of the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This area is expected to face the highest level of risk upon the Ark's ascent.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Most of the Outer Rim's infrastructure will be destroyed, and it is highly likely that the majority of its human inhabitants will perish.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We can't just abandon them all.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Outer Rim is not part of the Ark, and its inhabitants are not citizens of the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We cannot afford to waste resources on protecting the people of the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That was my initial assessment.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: However, with the support of Ingrid, the CEO of Elysion, a large number of shelters are currently being prepared.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: There should be no issue accommodating the estimated total population of the Outer Rim, which was provided by E.H.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: At least, that is the case in theory.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The question is whether those in the Outer Rim will actually accept this.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is correct. They currently believe this to be a purge of the Outer Rim carried out by the Ark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I can see why they would think that.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: They were treated as less than human until recently. It's only natural they'd be suspicious when they're suddenly told to move into shelters in the Ark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Having the Central Government intervene would only make matters worse. We have no choice but to entrust this entirely to Ingrid and E.H.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes. Currently, the Exotic Squad and Underworld Queen Squad are utilizing intimidation and force to coerce the inhabitants of the Outer Rim...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Correction: coaxing them through persuasion. Things are progressing smoothly, and we have shown significant success.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Good. Any other issues?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Presently, there are no other issues that would directly affect the Ark's ascent.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: All right. Proceed as planned.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Let us move on to the next matter.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: It's certain that a massive swarm of Raptures will converge on us after the Ark's ascent.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Correct. That is certain.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: The Queen will come to finish us off herself.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Correct. That is certain.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: What are our chances?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I did not expect to give such an uncertain assessment,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: but we have a fighting chance.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Ark's military strength is currently at its peak since its establishment.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Despite the Raptures' overwhelming numerical superiority, the Ark possesses several means to overcome this disadvantage.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The alliance with the Four Beasts, including Eden, is also promising.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The crucial factor now lies in how few casualties we can sustain while securing victory against the Raptures' elite forces.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Among them, the greatest threat will undoubtedly be the Queen, who has taken control of Liliweiss's body.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: While Liliweiss's body is undoubtedly the strongest of its kind, there is an undeniable limit to its usage.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: If that limit is surpassed, the outcome of this battle becomes uncertain.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: There is no need for such concerns.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: We will emerge victorious.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes. I will trust your judgment.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: What happens after the Ark ascends?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We will deploy large-scale optical camouflage.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It will shield the entire Ark and distort the Raptures' perception.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Which is precisely why we must eliminate the Raptures' elite forces.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: If they possess intelligence, they will remember our location regardless of whether we conceal ourselves with optical camouflage.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: ... All right. When can we execute the plan?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: If we expedite the process, we can be ready in three days. If we make thorough preparations, it will be possible in two weeks.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: That's quick.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It is only possible because this is a one-time defensive operation.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Good. Continue with the preparations.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Once the Ark has ascended and all attacks have been repelled...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: What will become of the Ark?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That remains uncertain.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This is uncharted territory, even for me.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: All possibilities remain open.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Therefore, it cannot be predicted.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I see. Ascending to the surface won't be the end of things, will it?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: But doesn't it excite you?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Excitement, huh.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Yes. Humanity has spent over a century buried underground...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: At last, we will finally set foot on the surface beneath the sunlight.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: A new world will open up for everyone.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That does sound exciting.
